# Starlight Whispers
## Scripture
"For God, who said, 'Let light shine out of darkness,' made his light shine in our hearts to give us the light of the knowledge of God’s glory displayed in the face of Christ." - 2 Corinthians 4:6

## Reflection
As we gaze up at the night sky, we're reminded of the vastness of God's creation. The stars, like diamonds scattered across the velvet expanse, whisper secrets of the universe. Just as starlight travels across immense distances to reach our eyes, God's light shines in our hearts, illuminating the path to His glory. In the darkest moments, His light breaks through, giving us hope and guidance. The starlight whispers of God's presence, reminding us that we're not alone in the vastness of creation.

## Prayer
Dear Heavenly Father, as we marvel at the starry night sky, we're humbled by the reminder of Your infinite power and glory. Help us to receive the light of Your knowledge, shining in our hearts through Christ. May Your starlight whispers guide us through life's journey, illuminating our path and filling us with hope. As we bask in the radiance of Your glory, may our hearts overflow with worship and gratitude, reflecting the light of Your love to a world in need. Shine Your light in us, Lord, that we may shine for You. Amen.
